tokens.name: brand-acid
tokens.usage: Hero colour, lime. Daytime, fresh, outdoors. Big fields, stickers, highlights, the wordmark on ink. Never as small text on oat or paper (1.1:1).

tokens.name: brand-grape
tokens.usage: Second brand colour, electric grape. Evening, nightlife, neon. Big fields, stories, New in Town. Text on it: brand-oat (5.7:1) or brand-acid (5.1:1), never brand-ink (2.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-grape-deep
tokens.usage: Deep grape for layered night layouts and the venue report. Text on it: brand-oat (10.9:1), brand-acid (9.8:1), brand-lavender (6.9:1). Sits next to brand-ink only with a rule between them.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Plum-black ink. All text by day, dark grounds, outlines, hard shadows. Keeps green and purple feeling like lime and plum, not chemicals.

tokens.name: brand-oat
tokens.usage: Warm oat. The daytime ground and the text colour on ink and grape. Frames food photography; never a cold white.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Paper. Cards and report pages on oat, email body.

tokens.name: brand-green-deep
tokens.usage: Herb green, readable as text: 4.6:1 on oat, 5.1:1 on paper. Rank-up numbers and green labels by day. On brand-acid only at 24px+ (4.1:1).

tokens.name: brand-lavender
tokens.usage: Lavender. Purple as text and lines by night: 9.4:1 on ink. Never on oat or paper.

tokens.name: brand-beet
tokens.usage: Beet / plum accent. Dish of the Month, wine moments. Text-safe on oat (6.8:1), paper (7.6:1) and acid (6.1:1). Never beside brand-grape.

tokens.name: brand-chili
tokens.usage: Chili, the smallest accent. Rising arrows and 'hot' stamps. On oat only 3.5:1: use at 24px+ or as a mark, never for body text. Never on brand-acid for text (3.1:1), never beside brand-grape.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and canvas background. Oat by day, ink by night.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, report pages, email body on ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground and paper (14.9:1 / 16.6:1 day; 14.9:1 / 13.3:1 night).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: method lines, captions, districts. 6.0:1 on ground and 6.7:1 on paper by day; 8.2:1 and 7.3:1 by night.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Bold rules, sticker outlines, chart baselines. Always full-strength ink, never grey.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and table dividers only. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: field-green
tokens.usage: Acid field: Heat Check covers, highlight stickers, the hero bar. Both themes. Text on it: on-field-green only.

tokens.name: on-field-green
tokens.usage: Text and marks on field-green (13.3:1). Always ink, both themes.

tokens.name: field-purple
tokens.usage: Grape field: stories, New in Town, evening content. Both themes. Text on it: on-field-purple or brand-acid.

tokens.name: on-field-purple
tokens.usage: Text and marks on field-purple (5.7:1) and field-purple-deep (10.9:1). Always oat.

tokens.name: field-ink
tokens.usage: Ink block inside a day layout (stat blocks, the follow slide). Both themes; by night give it a rule so it separates from ground.

tokens.name: on-field-ink
tokens.usage: Text on field-ink (14.9:1). Numbers on field-ink may use brand-acid (13.3:1).

tokens.name: field-purple-deep
tokens.usage: Deep grape block for the venue report cover and night stories. Text: on-field-purple, brand-acid, brand-lavender.

tokens.name: field-inverse
tokens.usage: The block that is the opposite of ground: tags, solid stamps, buttons. Ink by day, oat by night, so it never disappears.

tokens.name: on-field-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on field-inverse (14.9:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-green
tokens.usage: Green as text and lines on ground and paper: rank-up numbers, '+12 places', method ticks.

tokens.name: text-purple
tokens.usage: Purple as text and lines on ground and paper: 'New' labels, evening tags, links in email.

tokens.name: accent-beet
tokens.usage: Beet as text and marks on ground and paper (6.8:1 day, 5.2:1 night). Dish of the Month.

tokens.name: accent-chili
tokens.usage: Chili as a mark or 24px+ text on ground and paper (3.5:1 day, 6.8:1 night). Rising arrows.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Default bar, column and dot fill. Solid, no gradient.

tokens.name: chart-highlight
tokens.usage: The one bar or point the story is about. By day give it a 3px chart-outline so it holds 3:1 against ground.

tokens.name: chart-outline
tokens.usage: Outline on chart-highlight and on photo frames, both themes.

tokens.name: chart-up
tokens.usage: Rank movement up, growth, new highs.

tokens.name: chart-new
tokens.usage: New entries and openings in charts.

tokens.name: chart-flat
tokens.usage: No movement, held rank, context series. Public charts never colour a decline red; venue reports use chart-flat for fewer posts.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid, 2px offset: 5.7:1 on ground and 6.3:1 on paper by day; 13.3:1 / 11.9:1 by night.

styles.name: number-hero
styles.usage: Rank numerals as graphic elements. 320px on a 1080 canvas.

styles.name: display-xxl
styles.usage: Web hero and report cover headlines. 128px on a 1080 canvas.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Place names on item slides (72px on a 1080 canvas), section headlines.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Card titles, big stats, email headlines.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Sticker text, list rows, chart labels.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Counted from 3,400 posts by 900 creators, 1–31 October.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Diners follow it for the lists. Creators share it because they get credited.
styles.usage: Body copy on web, email and reports. Never below 15px on web, never below 32px on a 1080 canvas.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Posts, views and creators are our own counts.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Creator handles, button text, UI labels. Handles are always written with the @.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Pixel labels in caps: series stamps, dates, 'counted by Munchwerk'. Minimum 11px on web, 24px on a 1080 canvas. One or two words per line, never sentences.

styles.name: stamp-l
styles.usage: Larger stamps on covers and the venue report.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, stamp padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Sticker padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Component padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on web and email.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps on web.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Block gaps on canvases.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large block gaps, report margins.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero padding on web.

tokens.name: canvas-gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin on every 1080px Instagram canvas. Nothing but a bleeding field crosses it.

tokens.name: story-safe
tokens.usage: Top and bottom safe zones on a 1080×1920 story: no text or logo inside them.

tokens.name: radius-hard
tokens.usage: Default. Fields, bars, photo frames, rules are square.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Tags and movement pills.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Stickers, the monogram tile, cards on paper.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Large stickers on canvases (scale with the sticker).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill stickers and handle chips.

shadow.note: Shadows are hard offsets, never blurred. Ink by day, acid by night, grape or acid when the sticker itself is ink.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-s
tokens.usage: Small stickers, pills, email buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Stickers, cards, photo frames on web (16px on a 1080 canvas).

tokens.name: shadow-hard-l
tokens.usage: Hero stickers and the video still frame on canvases.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-grape
tokens.usage: Offset shadow in grape, for ink or oat stickers in evening layouts.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-acid
tokens.usage: Offset shadow in acid, for ink stickers by day.

stroke.note: Rule and outline weights. Bold rules are part of the look; use them instead of shadows or grey dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Sticker and photo-frame outline on web (6px on a 1080 canvas).

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Section rules, chart baselines.

tokens.name: stroke-rule-bold
tokens.usage: Hero rules under headlines, the top bar on covers.

tilt.note: Stickers and tags tilt; nothing else does. At most two tilted elements per composition, never the same angle twice.

tokens.name: tilt-left
tokens.usage: Default sticker tilt.

tokens.name: tilt-right
tokens.usage: Second sticker or tag in the same composition.

tokens.name: tilt-hard
tokens.usage: One hero sticker on a cover.

bite.note: The bite: one circle cut from the top-right of a shape. Radius = 16% of the shape's height, centre 6% in from the corner. One bite per composition.

tokens.name: bite-ratio
tokens.usage: Bite radius as a share of the bitten shape's height.

tokens.name: bite-inset
tokens.usage: How far the bite centre sits in from the top-right corner, as a share of height.
